name: Discussion Brief Cards
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Cuts long discussion text without splitting an emoji.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Long discussion text is now shortened without cutting an emoji in half.
tip: Select Refresh on a card to load the current text and answer state after a discussion changes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Discussion Brief Cards is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep project discussions beside your notes.
